title: FrankenTerm canonical test-log row
description: Canonical JSONL row shape emitted by ft-test-log (crates/ft-test-log/src/lib.rs TestLogger). G52 substrate for reality-check epic ft-tf6g3. Schema-version constant: ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION = ft.test-log.row.v1. Default output path: target/test-logs/<area>/<test>/<run_id>.jsonl (overridable via FT_TEST_LOG_DIR env var). Bead: ft-tf6g3.40.

schema_version.description: Stable schema version. Must match ROW_SCHEMA_VERSION in crates/ft-test-log/src/lib.rs.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the row was emitted.

test.description: Test function name (Rust #[test] fn name) or doctest origin string. Used for grouping rows within an area.

kind.description: One of the 7 canonical row kinds. Test authors should prefer the named helpers on TestLogger (.assertion, .stage_enter, .stage_exit, .measurement, .error, .decision, .evidence_emit) over emitting kind strings manually.

run_id.description: UUIDv7 identifier (time-ordered). Generated once per TestLogger instance so rows from the same test naturally sort and rows across instances don't collide. The '7' in the third hex group anchors the version.
